sourceAssessment.operator: Government of Bihar, Directorate of Land Records & Survey; NIC BhuNaksha deployment
sourceAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public hierarchy, map extents and anonymous plot hit-testing for selected Nautan revenue mauzas; not proven citywide coverage.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Official viewer loaded; current JavaScript/configuration inspected.
Viewer hierarchy markup returned; state 10 is Bihar.
Returned Nautan mauzas including Nautan Khas 0106, Nautan Dube 0100, and Sanseraiya 0127; survey/map-instance/sheet choices were also exposed.
Returned EPSG:32645 extent for Nautan Khas CS Map sheet 01: xmin 248366.3729571819, ymin 2947880.9131845324, xmax 251100.23304716364, ymax 2949488.712745228.
Bounded anonymous hit-test returned opaque public id OuEc5iR_RjyZOMUQz1kN5w and plot number/kide 284; attributes_json was null. This is a native source identity lead, not retained as a polygon.
WMS raster route responded for map display; GetFeatureInfo attempt returned PNG rather than safe vector/JSON geometry, so no polygon was retained.
Plot-detail route required authorization; no login or retry with credentials was attempted.

verifiedParcelResponse.qualification: ID-only anonymous hit-test; not sufficient for runtime adapter qualification.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Bihar's official BhuNaksha public viewer for selected Nautan revenue mauzas and survey sheets.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Hierarchy, CRS/extent, and one bounded anonymous hit-test were verified for Nautan Khas CS Map sheet 01.
limits: A single hit-test is not citywide absence/presence evidence.
Map extent miss, null attributes, raster response, or 401 detail route do not establish absence of parcels.
No public vector polygon endpoint was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The WUP point was not used to force a parcel hit, and no safe native polygon geometry was returned. Coverage across all Nautan town/circle mauzas and survey states remains unverified.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently qualify whether Bihar BhuNaksha can supply stable parcel geometry through an approved public vector route; keep runtime integration held until then.
